battlenet_panel.ensure_normal: Keep Battle.net normal (log in at startup and keep running)
battlenet_panel.guard_desc: From app start, keep Battle.net running and logged in: ensure the region first (CN / Asia, restart with --setregion when needed), then log in automatically (CN NetEase web / Asia form typed in), and restart by the timeout rules above.
battlenet_panel.credentials_desc: CN and Asia accounts are saved separately in the user data folder (password encrypted). Switching logs out via the avatar menu and logs in with the new account; another region restarts Battle.net with the region argument.
battlenet_panel.abnormal_restart: Restart on abnormal timeout (connecting / disconnected / login failed / stuck loading)
battlenet_panel.login_restart: Restart on login timeout (login screen / browser confirm / logging in)
battlenet_panel.region_prompt: Ask to restart Battle.net when the region changes
battlenet_panel.region_restart_ask: Region switched to {0}. Quit and restart Battle.net now with the official region argument?
battlenet_panel.net_hold_enabled: Network hold: ensure the client, start / resume the D4 download, switch to D3 when done
battlenet_panel.net_hold_on_boot: Start at boot and hold the network
battlenet_panel.net_hold_desc: While the app runs it checks at this interval (default 60 s): Battle.net is only started with a working internet connection (started offline it drops the login); offline it rechecks every 15 s. Once logged in it opens the D4 page; when not installed it clicks Install, sets the install dialog location to the D4 install path above (empty = Battle.net's suggestion) and clicks Continue and Start Install; when paused or queued (e.g. after a network drop) it clicks Resume Download unless you paused it here; when D4 is complete it switches to the D3 page and stops. While D3 or ROSBOT runs it never brings Battle.net to the front. Start at boot keeps one shortcut to this app in the Startup folder (idempotent).
battlenet_panel.net_hold_waiting_window: Waiting for the Battle.net window (not brought to front while a game runs)
battlenet_panel.net_hold_not_owned: D4 not owned, switched to D3
battlenet_panel.net_hold_history: Check history (newest first, saved in net_hold_history.jsonl)
battlenet_panel.net_hold_no_progress: No download progress yet (recorded once the D4 page shows it)
battlenet_panel.net_hold_install_path_failed: Install path not applied (check the path or choose it manually)
battlenet_panel.net_hold_user_paused: Paused by you (Resume download turns auto-resume back on)
battlenet_panel.net_hold_control_failed: Not done (Battle.net not running or the D4 page is not in that state)
battlenet_panel.d4_branch_ask:
Diablo IV in {0} is the {1} (branch "{2}"). After switching to {3}, Battle.net will repair or re-download part of the game in this shared folder.

Yes: switch
No: switch and open the D4 page
Cancel: do not switch

decompile.tools_desc: Downloaded into the program data folder: ILSpy (.NET to C#, needs the .NET SDK), de4dot-cex (.NET deobfuscation), autoit-ripper (compiled AutoIt to .au3, needs Python), UPX (unpack). Already installed tools are kept.
decompile.rosbot_desc: Main program (deobfuscate, then decompile) plus every plugin DLL; writes settings_fields.md with all setting names (RoS-BoT.ini keys). Method bodies protected by DNGuard HVM are decrypted only at runtime and stay as stubs.
decompile.rbassist_desc: Compiled AutoIt program: extracts the .au3 script and embedded files (UPX is unpacked first when needed).
decompile.file_desc: Detects the type automatically: .NET assembly, compiled AutoIt, or native code (not supported).
decompile.recover_sources: Export available sources and attempt DNGuard recovery
decompile.chain_desc: Checks that all tools run, then decompiles configured ROSBOT, plugins and RBAssist into a new folder. Saves chain_report.json. DNGuard placeholder bodies are reported as partial recovery. Select a restored assembly under Any file to inspect an external recovery result.
decompile.passed: Chain passed: tools ran and all targets produced output without detected DNGuard placeholders.
decompile.incomplete: Chain incomplete: check the log and chain_report.json for missing tools, failed targets or protected method bodies.
decompile.chain_rosbot_missing: CHECK ROSBOT: FAIL configured executable not found
decompile.rosbot_not_found: ROSBOT exe not found in '{dir}' (set the ROSBOT directory on the Rosbot tab or use Scan)
decompile.rbassist_not_found: RBAssist exe not found (choose it with Browse)

rosbot_bridge.title: ROSBOT plugin: CoreNode Bridge (current map)

plugin_action.uptodate_tip: The installed plugin equals the bundled one and ROSBOT uses it. Click to check and repair again.
plugin_action.restarttoload_tip: The plugin was installed or updated, but the running ROSBOT still uses the old one (or none). Click to restart ROSBOT only (D3 kept, game not left); a taken control pauses the new ROSBOT again.
plugin_action.restarttoupdate_tip: The bundled plugin is newer than the installed one, which the running ROSBOT locks. Click to close ROSBOT, install the new plugin and start ROSBOT again (D3 kept, game not left).
plugin_action.restarting_tip: ROSBOT is being closed and started again; the button returns when done.
plugin_action.install_tip: This app's own ROSBOT plugin, installed to ROSBOT's plugins\CoreNodeBridge. While ROSBOT runs it writes the current map (level area SNO), scene, world, town / rift / greater rift level, paragon, health, blood shards, keys, current sequence and recent maps to state.json once per second; this panel reads it every second. Enable CoreNode Bridge once in ROSBOT's plugin list; after updating the plugin restart ROSBOT to load it. Maps only have numeric ids; name the current map below.

rosbot_bridge.auto_install: Install / update in the current ROSBOT automatically (at start and when the ROSBOT path changes)
rosbot_bridge.outdated: differs from the bundled build, click Install to update
rosbot_bridge.stale: Data is stale: ROSBOT stopped or the plugin is disabled
rosbot_bridge.not_in_game: ROSBOT running, hero not in game
rosbot_bridge.result_installed: Plugin installed (restart ROSBOT if it is running)
rosbot_bridge.result_no_bundle: Plugin file missing next to the app; rebuild the app
rosbot_bridge.result_locked: ROSBOT is using the plugin; stop ROSBOT, then install
rosbot_bridge.result_failed: Plugin install failed, see the log
rosbot_bridge.not_installed_hint: Plugin not installed: click Install / update plugin, or check the ROSBOT folder
rosbot_bridge.rosbot_stopped: Plugin installed, ROSBOT not running: data appears once ROSBOT runs
rosbot_bridge.not_loaded: ROSBOT is running but the plugin writes no data: enable CoreNode Bridge in ROSBOT's plugin list; restart ROSBOT after installing or updating
rosbot_bridge.not_botting: Plugin loaded, ROSBOT is not botting (the plugin writes data only while ROSBOT bots); if it is botting, enable CoreNode Bridge in ROSBOT's plugin list
rosbot_bridge.starting: Plugin just started: no game data for 30 s after ROSBOT starts (keeps ROSBOT's startup undisturbed)
rosbot_bridge.follow_town_portal_key_tip: D3 town portal key (default t), one setting for all: town standby outside town, follow mode when the leader is lost outside town and the trigger action "town portal" bring D3 to the front and press it.
rosbot_bridge.filter: Pickup filter (one name fragment per line, matches name or internal name; matches marked ★)
rosbot_bridge.filter_auto: Pick up matches automatically when a rift ends
rosbot_bridge.filter_saved: Pickup filter saved to the plugin folder
rosbot_bridge.npc_target_hint: Without a list selection the nearest NPC matching this name fragment is used
rosbot_bridge.carried_note: ROSBOT's plugin API exposes no backpack slots: this lists every item the hero holds (backpack, stash, worn); worn items are marked [Equipped]. Names are internal game names.
rosbot_bridge.ui_id_hint: ROSBOT UI element id (decimal or 0x hex); not clicked when the element is not shown
rosbot_bridge.capabilities:
Supported by ROSBOT's plugin API: current map / scene / world, town and rift state, drops nearby (name, quality, ancient / primal, distance), NPCs nearby, monster and elite counts, items held, walking to a target (MoveTo), interacting (Interact, i.e. left-click open NPC / pick up), picking up (PickupItem), clicking UI elements by id, stash events.
Not supported (ROSBOT does not expose it): backpack slot positions, buying and selling, right-click actions, reading a vendor's goods. Buying / selling is only possible by clicking known UI element ids.
Pickup record: ROSBOT has no pickup event; an item that vanishes from the ground within 6 yards of the hero counts as picked.
rosbot_bridge.command_not_sent: Not sent: ROSBOT plugin folder not found
rosbot_bridge.command_busy: Not sent: the previous command is still waiting for the plugin; try again when it has run
rosbot_bridge.select_target: Select a target in the list first (or enter a name / UI element id)
rosbot_bridge.build_duplicate: Not added: all {0} gear set(s) are already listed (same skills, runes, passives, gear, Kanai's Cube and follower)
rosbot_bridge.build_equip_in_town_tip: When the backpack holds items closer to the gear set (maxroll) than the worn ones, the next town visit holds ROSBOT's town run (in follow mode: before the banner), opens the inventory and right-clicks them on, then ROSBOT salvages as usual. Each item is tried once per run.
rosbot_bridge.build_gamble_unaligned_tip: Rewrites ROSBOT's gamble settings (RosBotGamblingSettings.ini): only the unaligned gear-set slots, bought by ROSBOT at Kadala once the blood shards are full; your own settings come back when everything is aligned or this is off.
rosbot_bridge.build_aligned: Worn gear matches the gear set
rosbot_bridge.build_hint: Items are matched by game balance id, internal name and name; affixes need the CoreNodeBridge plugin 1.2+ (affixes the game does not expose, such as legendary powers or skill damage, are not checked).
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_tip: Set the skill bar, runes and passives in game to this gear set (you choose the method)
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_plugin_desc: ROSBOT with the CoreNode Bridge plugin reads the hero level and exactly which skills, runes and passives are active: correct slots are skipped and the result is verified.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_plugin_off: Not available: ROSBOT with the CoreNode Bridge plugin is not running.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_image_desc: Finds the skills by their cached icons on screen and sets every slot; runes are read with OCR. The hero level cannot be checked.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_requirements: Needs hero level {0} and Elective Mode on (D3 Options > Gameplay). D3 must be in game and visible; do not use mouse or keyboard until it finishes. A botting ROSBOT is paused and resumed afterwards.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_busy: A switch is already running or no gear set is selected.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_outcome_done: Done: {0} skill(s) and {1} passive(s) set, everything matches the gear set.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_outcome_partial: Finished with {2} mismatch(es): {0} skill(s) and {1} passive(s) set ({3}).
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_outcome_leveltoolow: Hero level too low ({3}); level 70 is needed.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_outcome_actionbarnotf: Skill bar not recognized ({3}); make sure D3 is in game with the bar visible.
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_outcome_skillnotinlis: Skill {3} not offered in the skill list: turn on Elective Mode (Options > Gameplay).
rosbot_bridge.build_skill_switch_outcome_pluginunavail: The plugin did not answer ({3}); use the image method or start ROSBOT.
rosbot_bridge.npc_go_tip: Walk to {0} when a path exists and open it
rosbot_bridge.test_salvage_tip: Blacksmith window must be open (plugin clicks the salvage page and the salvage-all button)
rosbot_bridge.test_salvage_rule_tip: Blacksmith window open; screen-based, uses the TAB1 keep rule
rosbot_bridge.test_drop_rule_tip: Inventory open; screen-based, really drops what the TAB1 keep rule removes
rosbot_bridge.standby_tip: Clickable anywhere, also in town: pause monitoring and ROSBOT at once (F6 pause: ROSBOT keeps running, the game is not left; checked again when already paused, a newly started ROSBOT is paused too) and make sure the hero is in town: in town no key is pressed; outside town the town portal key is pressed at once and, with the plugin live, again after an interrupted cast until the hero arrives; a dead hero revives in town. No more tasks; the buttons here drive the hero through the plugin. End standby hands control back to ROSBOT.

standby_result.intown: ROSBOT paused, the hero stands by in town
standby_result.reviving: ROSBOT paused, the hero is dead; the plugin revives in town
standby_result.portalsent: ROSBOT paused, town portal key ({0}) pressed; kept until the hero is in town
standby_result.portalnotsent: ROSBOT paused, but the town portal key ({0}) was not sent: D3 window not found or input busy

hold_state.holding: ROSBOT held by the plugin (live data)
hold_state.unsupported: plugin hold unsupported, paused with F6

rosbot_bridge.hold_tip: Pause = app flow held and ROSBOT paused with F6 (not stopped); commands here then control the hero. Resume hands control back.
rosbot_bridge.hold_taken: Monitoring paused for this command (ROSBOT paused with F6); press Resume monitoring when done
rosbot_bridge.test_salvage_legendary_tip: Blacksmith window open; items chosen from plugin memory data (quality, ancient rank, backpack cell), build items kept, list logged first
rosbot_bridge.follow_tip: Follow the party leader, party member N, the nearest or the selected player. Party slots come from the town banners (seen once in town); the leader from the Leader attribute, else slot 1. The plugin never attacks (monitoring and ROSBOT stay paused). Lost outside town: the town portal key above; in town: the target's banner (Auto) or the chosen one. Pickup: matching items near the target.
rosbot_bridge.follow_select_player: Select a player in the list first
rosbot_bridge.follow_revive_tip: Dead while following: wait 8 s for a teammate (a party revive needs no click), then revive at corpse, else at checkpoint, else in town.
